panels.title: Rolling MASE vs persistence
panels.description: 1.0 ties 'tomorrow = today'. Above 1.0 the model is worse than doing nothing. Spec B measured 0.899 at h24 in backtest.

panels.title: Data freshness (days)
panels.description: Days since the newest ground-truth row. Red above 2. The upstream historical dump froze at 2026-01-18, so a large value here is the panel working, not failing.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT served_at, station_id, target_date, ROUND(prediction, 2) AS prediction, model_name FROM predictions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
targets.queryText: SELECT served_at, station_id, target_date, ROUND(prediction, 2) AS prediction, model_name FROM predictions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Scoring history (model vs persistence)
panels.description: Alerting uses the persistence rule: flag tomorrow when today's IQA already exceeds 50. Spec B measured the ML classifier as worse than that rule at every horizon (cost 787 vs 581 at h24), so the dashboard shows the rule.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT scored_at, window_days, n, ROUND(mae_model, 3) AS mae_model, ROUND(mae_persistence, 3) AS mae_persistence, ROUND(mase, 3) AS mase FROM scores ORDER BY scored_at DESC LIMIT 50
